features: Choose upgrades for yourself and your opponent.
Build an arsenal and survive escalating boss rounds.
controls: Use the on-screen controls to build your arsenal and fight.
Keyboard and mouse recommended; touch controls are available.

features: Build ships, factories, and modular space stations.
Connect production lines, manage power, and explore other worlds.
controls: Mouse / trackpad: select buildings, construct, and connect ports.
Scroll to zoom. Ship controls are shown when you board.

features: Explore 71 landable worlds across six fictional star systems, or start a separate Real Solar System expedition on Earth.
Build ships, stations, and colonies with connected production.
Assemble rockets with snapping, mirror/radial symmetry, move/rotate tools, staging and saved subassemblies.
Real Solar System includes 8 planets, 5 dwarf planets, and 32 selected moons at playable distances.
Explorer assist: optional landing checks, forgiving crashes, free recovery, and guided first steps.
Real Solar System bodies have distinct elongated, irregular and flattened silhouettes, with matching landing terrain.
Every Solar planet and moon has refreshed surface maps, geological relief and material detail; the giants have distinct cloud decks.
Solar System Scope orbital maps, Earth cloud patterns and night lights, Saturn rings, and a smooth blend into playable terrain.
A sculpted astronaut suit with a curved visor, detailed gloves and boots, and smooth walking, rover and survey-tool animation.
controls: WASD: walk or drive. Mouse: look around.
M: map. H: journal. Flight and building controls appear in their menus.
Shipyard: 1–4 tools, X symmetry, R mirror/radial, C angle snap; drag to orbit, Shift-drag to pan.

features: Dodge ten encounter types, including crushing jaws, proximity mines, comet rain, live wires, and wrecking balls.
Unlock a collection of ship skins, including Godly crates.
Bank through a neon starfield with engine trails, phase-drive rings, and immediate close-call feedback.
Every 1,000 score rolls a 25% boss chance. Destroy four random weapon modules, then the core, using one of three temporary guns.
controls: Drag or use A / D and arrow keys to steer. Tap Dash or press Space to phase through danger.
Choose ships and open crates from the game’s menu.
Boss fight: the gun fires automatically. Steer under a module to shoot it; use Dash to phase through attacks.

features: Collect resources and build an automated space industry.
Explore planets, unlock achievements, and expand your production.
controls: Click the star and resource objects to collect.
Use the game’s menus to buy producers and explore new planets.

features: Grapple through rooms, collect weapons, and choose upgrades.
Face a boss every five rooms, including the Blue Rival.
controls: Use the game’s mouse or touch controls to move, grapple, and fire.
Type admin during the game to open its admin tools.

features: Drive against three AI bumper cars on crumbling tiles.
Drift, bump rivals, and survive 30 symmetrical map layouts.
controls: WASD / arrows: drive. Space: drift.
Keep moving: tiles disappear after you drive over them.

features: Build an arcade, hire staff, and keep customers happy.
Unlock new attractions and grow into larger locations.
controls: Mouse / touch: choose attractions, place them, and manage the arcade.
Select people and machines to inspect their needs.

features: Meet 30 ducks across a campaign with three difficulties.
Play Endless with every duck unlocked.
controls: Click / tap a duck, then a lawn tile to place it.
Collect breadcrumbs and protect each lane from the dogs.

features: Recover salvage and descend through an endless ocean.
Manage oxygen while avoiding creatures and obstacles.
controls: WASD / arrows: move. Space: sonar.
Touch salvage pods or press E nearby to recover them.

features: Stack an endless supply of cargo onto a moving ship.
Uneven weight tilts the hull; cargo can slide and the ship can capsize.
controls: A / D or arrows: move the crane. Space: drop cargo.
P: pause. Balance heavy loads on both sides.

features: Clear 100 campaign heists, then unlock endless randomized jobs.
Sneak past guards, cameras, lasers, and locked vaults.
controls: WASD / arrows: move. Shift: sneak. E: interact; hold to open vaults.
Q: smoke once unlocked. P: pause.

features: Explore procedurally generated rooms in a sci-fi horror adventure.
Find supplies, shelter, and clues in saved worlds.
controls: Keyboard and mouse required. WASD: move; mouse: look.
E: interact. The game includes customizable key bindings.

features: Route trains through four yards and three shifts.
Collect medals and unlock new train colors.
controls: Click / tap switches, or use 1, 2, and 3.
S: slow trains. Keep the crossings clear.

features: Harvest stardust and buy an automated fleet.
Upgrade an expanding interstellar industry.
controls: Click / tap to harvest stardust.
Use the upgrade and producer buttons to automate production.

features: Build a colony and balance food, water, and resources.
Research technology and work toward an orbital launch.
controls: Click / tap tiles to inspect and build.
Use the colony menus to research and manage production.

features: Place defenses to protect a route from enemy waves.
Earn medals across maps, difficulties, and modes.
controls: Click / tap to place and upgrade towers.
Choose a map and difficulty before each run.

features: Record your movements and cooperate with your own echoes.
Solve six puzzle rooms using switches and timing.
controls: WASD / arrows: move. Space: record an echo.
C: clear recorded echoes.

features: Handle a two-minute cooking rush.
Prepare, cook, and serve three dishes as orders stack up.
controls: Click stations, or move with WASD and press E to interact.
Work through prep, cooking, and serving before time runs out.

features: Turn mirrors to guide a beam through every receiver.
Solve six light puzzles with undo and no time limit.
controls: Click mirrors to turn them. Arrows: select. Space: rotate.
Z: undo the previous turn.

features: Design a bridge, run a loaded truck across it, and watch every beam bend. Build lighter, stronger trusses across eight crossings.
Admin Tab prototype. Best scores and progress link to your save password.
controls: Click joints to connect · click empty grid to add a joint · Test bridge
P or Escape pauses. Restart begins the current challenge again.

features: Move the clouds. Time the rain. Keep a tiny hillside garden alive through changing winds without drowning it.
Admin Tab prototype. Best scores and progress link to your save password.
controls: Drag clouds · click Rain or hold Space · harvest automatically
P or Escape pauses. Restart begins the current challenge again.

features: 12 opening tables followed by endless generated rooms with increasing difficulty.
More obstacles and targets, tighter shots and smaller stars as you progress.
Felt-and-brass table art, reflected aim guides, marble impacts and an original quiet soundtrack.
controls: Click or drag to aim and release to shoot. Arrow keys fine-tune the angle; Space shoots.
Enter endless jumps straight to Room 13. P pauses. Cleared rooms are saved.

features: A compact cosmic pinball table with physical flippers, lively bumpers, lit lanes and a hungry drain. Three balls. Chase your best.
Admin Tab prototype. Best scores and progress link to your save password.
controls: A / D or arrows: flippers · Space launch · N nudge
P or Escape pauses. Restart begins the current challenge again.

features: Pack parcels, clear rows and columns, and build shipment streaks without a timer.
Layered packing sounds, dispatch chimes, parcel animations and shipment particles.
Your current van and best score travel with your save password.
controls: Keys 1–3 select parcels. R rotates. Click a van grid square to pack.
U unpacks the last move. P pauses.

features: 40 distinct anomalies across four detailed camera rooms.
Five night shifts with reference photos, layered ambient sound, and report feedback.
controls: Keys 1–4 switch cameras. Space compares reference and live images.
Click a changed object to report it. P pauses the shift.

features: Race three AI rivals across 30 symmetrical arenas that crumble beneath your wheels.
Switch between a first-person cockpit and an orbitable third-person chase camera.
Charge a drift boost, choose Easy / Normal / Hard, and track wins across the arenas.
controls: WASD / arrows: drive. Space: drift. C / V: switch camera.
Drag to orbit in third person; scroll to zoom; R resets the camera. P / Esc pauses, M mutes.

features: Drag expressive, colorful Boomkins into the pen matching their color before their fuses burn down.
Five difficulties: Easy, Normal, Hard, Chaos and Hyperchaos. Score 50 on the previous tier to unlock the next challenge.
Higher difficulties add changing colors, shuffling pens, hopping bombs and gusts of wind. One wrong pen or expired fuse ends the round.
controls: Click and drag a Boomkin into its matching pen.
Esc / P pauses. M toggles sound; N toggles music. Space retries after a round.

features: Race a visible robot through a 3D course of winding slides and floating doors.
Open sides let you steer or jump off anywhere. Gold launch pads provide extra lift or a sideways boost for shortcuts. Miss your landing and the race ends.
Choose Easy, Normal or Hard and keep your best winning times. Includes a lighter Chromebook graphics option.
A different course follows every win or loss. Restarts and unfinished rounds keep the same map; there is no manual course selector.
controls: Mobile: drag left / right to steer on the slide and in the air. Tap Jump with another finger; tap Pause to stop the race.
A / D: steer on the slide and in the air. W: tuck / dive. S: brake / air brake.
Space or the touch Jump button: jump off anywhere on the slide. Esc: pause. R: restart.

features: Build staged rockets using a blueprint editor and a live 3D preview. Save designs, launch probes or crewed missions, and recover your spacecraft.
Perform science experiments and complete missions to unlock better rocket parts in the Research Center.
Explore the Solar System, track active spacecraft, plan transfers and take crew on spacewalks. Includes advanced interstellar research.
Animated seas and methane lakes, swimming astronauts, and detailed planetary rings.
controls: Editor: drag parts onto the blueprint. X cycles symmetry; Ctrl+Z / Y undo and redo.
Flight: WASD / QE steer; Shift / Ctrl throttle; Z full throttle, X cut; Space stages. M opens the map, Esc pauses.

features: Collect 34 ducks and defend six worlds, each ending in a boss battle. Includes optional challenge levels.
Choose five duck types per level, with permanent loadout expansions up to eight.
Unlock five shops for ducks, upgrades, snacks and star rewards. Use each duck’s Quack Power during battle.
Includes an unlockable Endless Pond, Boss Rumble, trophies, and a Duck & Dog Field Guide.
controls: Mouse / trackpad: choose a duck card, then click a tile to place it.
1–8 select cards. Q: Quack Power. R: remove a duck. Space / P: pause. F: battle speed.

features: Upgrade your square and the boss between rounds across five stages, with 36 playable characters.
Continue unfinished runs, chase Endless records, or experiment in the Practice Workshop.
controls: A/D or arrows: move. Space/W/up: thrust. S/down: drop. Mouse: aim; weapons fire automatically.
Shift + direction: dash. E: utility. Esc/P: pause. Workshop: 1–4 select, Enter confirm, R reroll.
